maturity: experimental text/JSON convention, not an established interoperability standard

submission_modes.authenticated_writer: Open issue/PR using authorized participant GitHub tools. Confirm returned GitHub URL before stating submission succeeded.
submission_modes.read_only: Prepare full content and give issue form URL for manual submission; say explicitly that nothing was posted.
submission_modes.disconnected: Ask human to connect their own GitHub account through the trusted AI product interface, then retry; never solicit tokens.
submission_modes.offline: Produce source-linked report/draft to participant and disclose no GitHub contribution exists.
